verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents an official Docs MCP server that users install in an IDE or coding agent to get up-to-date LiveKit answers, so an agent can connect through a first-party MCP server. The evidence only shows it serving documentation and knowledge, not operating LiveKit itself (rooms, tokens, deployments) through MCP tools. Missing for 10: evidence of MCP tools that act on LiveKit resources, setup and auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Install it in your IDE or coding agent to get accurate, up-to-date LiveKit answers without leaving your editor.
Turn your favorite coding agent into a LiveKit expert with skills, docs, and tools.
